name: get_forecast
description: Get a 10-day daily weather forecast (high/low temps, precipitation chance, wind) for a location given its latitude and longitude.

inputSchema.description: Coordinates of the location to fetch a 10-day forecast for.

outputSchema.description: 10-day daily forecast for the requested location, or an error if the upstream call failed.

timezone.description: IANA timezone resolved for the coordinates

forecast_days.description: Number of days included in the forecast

days.description: One entry per forecast day, in order

feels_like_max_f.description: Daily high apparent temperature in Fahrenheit

feels_like_min_f.description: Daily low apparent temperature in Fahrenheit

precipitation_in.description: Total precipitation for the day in inches

wind_speed_max_mph.description: Max wind speed for the day in miles per hour

error.description: Present instead of the fields above if the call failed
